title: StigmergicCommitTemporalShieldConfig
description: Schema for bounded monotonic past-jitter and UTC normalization on version-control state commits (OPSTACK-KERNEL-v2.2 Invariants 4, 6, 21, 22, 24, 25).

max_lookback_window_seconds.description: Maximum backward jitter window in seconds, bounded below by parent commit timestamp.

force_utc_zero_offset.description: Mandates +0000 / Z UTC formatting to strip local longitudinal timezone headers.
